from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import importlib.util, json, hashlib, copy

ROOT=Path('/workspace/sites/portplan-review')
RUN=ROOT/'artifacts/v10-frozen-first/first-run'
EXPECTED='33d07f60afb4b4248682badc631512a54070cca22fd106c7dd5062d4669bf9c2'
def load_module(name,path):
 s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m);return m
review=load_module('v10_loss_review',ROOT/'scripts/review-v10.py')
old=load_module('v9_loss_helpers',ROOT/'scripts/diagnose-v9-losses.py')
ledger=review.ledger
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def canonical(x):return json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)
def vh(x):return hashlib.sha256(canonical(x).encode()).hexdigest()
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def bind(p):return {'path':str(Path(p).relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':sha(p)}
def require(condition,reason):
 if not condition:raise ValueError(reason)
def checked(a):
 p=RUN/a['path'];require(sha(p)==a['sha256'],'Original artifact hash differs');return p,read(p)
index_path=RUN/'complete.json';require(sha(index_path)==EXPECTED,'V10 original index hash differs')
index=read(index_path);frozen=RUN.parent;manifest_path=frozen/'manifest.json';manifest=read(manifest_path)
sources={str(index_path.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(index_path),str(manifest_path.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(manifest_path)}
require(index['protocolHash']==manifest['protocolHash'],'Protocol binding differs')
require(sha(frozen/'source/data/protocol-v10.json')==index['protocolHash'],'Original protocol bytes differ')
relevant={}
for name in ['scripts/highs-planner-v10.mjs','scripts/highs-planner-v8.mjs','scripts/highs-service-v8.py','scripts/review-v5.py','scripts/review-v10.py']:
 p=frozen/'source'/name
 require(sha(p)==manifest['implementationHashes'][name],'Frozen source hash differs')
 relevant[name]=sha(p)
losses=index['summary']['panels']['stress']['comparisons']['v10VsHiGHS']['completion']['lostEpisodeIds']
require(losses==[f'v10-stress-new-arrivals-tight-n24-r3::repeat-{a}'for a in [1,2,3]],'V10 pressure loss set differs')
all_pairs={}
for panel,summary in index['summary']['panels'].items():
 all_pairs[panel]={key:{'baselineMethod':c['baselineMethod'],'candidateMethod':c['candidateMethod'],
   'gainedEpisodeCount':c['completion']['gainedEpisodeCount'],'lostEpisodeCount':c['completion']['lostEpisodeCount'],
   'netCompletedEpisodeCount':c['completion']['gainedEpisodeCount']-c['completion']['lostEpisodeCount'],
   'lostEpisodeIds':c['completion']['lostEpisodeIds'],'gainedEpisodeIds':c['completion']['gainedEpisodeIds']}
   for key,c in summary['comparisons'].items() if key.startswith('v10Vs')}
episodes=[];groups={}
for identifier in losses:
 case_id,a=identifier.split('::repeat-');a=int(a)
 case=next(c for c in index['cases']if c['id']==case_id);inp,source=checked(case['inputArtifact']);sources[str(inp.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(inp)
 repeat=case['repeats'][a-1];loaded={}
 for method in ['stableHiGHSV10','highsV8']:
  p,e=checked(repeat['policies'][method]['artifact']);sources[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(p)
  require(e['caseId']==case_id and e['repeatIndex']==a and e['method']==method and e['algorithmSeed']==repeat['algorithmSeed'],'Episode identity mismatch')
  loaded[method]=(p,e,review.audit_episode(source['nominalScenario'],source['events'],e['result'],e['episodeId'],5000,method=method,call_budget=200))
 vp,ve,va=loaded['stableHiGHSV10'];bp,be,ba=loaded['highsV8'];v,b=ve['result'],be['result']
 require(not v['complete']and b['complete'],'Expected loss pair')
 snapshot=old.reconstruct(source['nominalScenario'],source['events'],v);day=snapshot['minEventDay'];trace=v['plannerTrace'][day]
 fixed=snapshot['fixedEvents'];nominal=source['nominalScenario'];forced=[]
 for box in nominal['containers']:
  locks=fixed.get(box['id'],{})
  starts=[locks['unloadDay']]if 'unloadDay'in locks else list(range(max(day,box['releaseDay']),box['dueDay']-box['unloadDays']+2))
  if starts and all(start<=day<start+box['unloadDays']for start in starts):
   forced.append({'id':box['id'],'containerInput':box,'physicalLocks':locks,
    'allUnloadStartsIgnoringOtherResources':starts,'reason':'fixed_continuous_unloading'if 'unloadDay'in locks else 'pending_floor_plus_delivery_deadline',
    'minimumWarehouseOccupancyAtFailureDay':1})
 cap=ledger.capacity(snapshot['scenario'],'warehouse',day)
 proof={'proofType':'independent_mandatory_warehouse_occupancy_lower_bound','day':day,
  'resource':'warehouse','forcedContainers':forced,'minimumDemand':len(forced),'publicCapacity':cap,
  'violation':len(forced)>cap,'independentlyProvenObservedPrefixInfeasible':len(forced)>cap,
  'scope':'failure-day public observation and original physical prefix only; no future realization, solver, or JS used',
  'derivation':'Any legal schedule must keep every locked continuous unload interval and put every pending unload no earlier than day. Superset unload domains are used; occupancy common to every possible start is a valid lower bound.'}
 require(proof['violation'],'Expected strict necessary capacity contradiction')
 cache=trace['stabilitySelection']['beforeDates']
 independent_cache_flags=review.v9.independent_candidate_flags(snapshot['scenario'],cache,fixed,day)
 require(independent_cache_flags[:2]==(False,True),'Expected resource-invalid but lock-valid cached dates')
 div=old.divergence(v,b,day)
 require(div['firstDivergentAcceptedDates']['day']==1 and div['firstDivergentPhysicalExecutionDayBeforeFailure']==1,'Expected D1 path divergence')
 selection_history=[]
 for call in v['plannerTrace']:
  q=call['stabilitySelection']
  selection_history.append({'day':call['day'],'decisionReason':q['decisionReason'],
     'proposalChangedEventCount':q.get('proposalChangedEventCount'),'changedEventCount':q.get('changedEventCount'),
     'nativeCostMinusCacheKRW':q.get('nativeCostMinusCacheKRW'),'candidateSource':call.get('candidateSource')})
 d4=copy.deepcopy(v['plannerTrace'][4]['stabilitySelection'])
 before={r['id']:r for r in d4['beforeDates']};proposal={r['id']:r for r in d4['proposalDates']};c17=case_id+'-C017'
 require(before[c17]['unloadDay']==4 and proposal[c17]['unloadDay']==8 and d4['proposalChangedEventCount']==29 and d4['nativeCostMinusCacheKRW']==0,'D4 tie evidence differs')
 # Independently validate both D4 endpoints against only that day observation.
 past4={}
 for entry in v['timeline'][:4]:
  for event in entry['executedEvents']:past4.setdefault(event['id'],{})[ledger.EVENT_FIELDS[event['event']]]=event['day']
 actual=ledger.realize(nominal,source['events']);obs4,_=ledger.observed_snapshot(nominal,actual,source['events'],4)
 d4_audits={}
 for side in ['before','proposal','after']:
  rows=d4[side+'Dates'];ledger.audit_dates(obs4,rows,'D4 '+side,past4,4)
  totals=review.reprice_dates(obs4,rows)
  for field,amount in totals.items():ledger.close(d4[side+'Fees'][field],amount,'D4 tie '+field)
  d4_audits[side]={'valid':True,'fees':totals,'datesSha256':vh(old.dates(rows))}
 baseline_on_prefix=old.optional_audit(snapshot,b['timeline'][day]['decisions'],'native baseline on V10 prefix')
 native=copy.deepcopy(trace['nativeCertificate']);gate=copy.deepcopy(trace['stabilitySelection']['nativeGate'])
 require(native['provenInfeasible']and not native['hasIncumbent']and gate['receivedAtMs']<200 and not trace['hardTimeout'],'Expected timely native infeasible result')
 groups.setdefault(snapshot['modelIdentityHash'],[]).append(ve['episodeId'])
 episodes.append({'episodeId':ve['episodeId'],'caseId':case_id,'repeatIndex':a,'algorithmSeed':repeat['algorithmSeed'],
  'originalInput':bind(inp),'candidateEpisode':bind(vp),'baselineEpisode':bind(bp),
  'candidateOriginalComplete':False,'baselineOriginalComplete':True,
  'originalFailure':v['failure'],'originalEpisodeWallMs':v['wallTimeMs'],
  'candidateOriginalIndependentAudit':va,'baselineOriginalIndependentAudit':ba,
  'failureSnapshot':snapshot,'nativeCertificate':native,'nativeGate':gate,
  'callWallMs':trace['callWallMs'],'plannerWallMs':trace['wallTimeMs'],'hardTimeout':trace['hardTimeout'],
  'originalCacheAudit':copy.deepcopy(trace['stages']['cacheAudit']),
  'independentCacheAudit':{'scheduleValid':independent_cache_flags[0],'freezeValid':independent_cache_flags[1]},
  'independentNecessaryConditionProof':proof,**div,'baselineFailureDayPlanOnCandidateSnapshot':baseline_on_prefix,
  'selectionHistory':selection_history,'day4TieSelectionOriginal':d4,'day4EndpointsIndependentAudits':d4_audits,
  'mechanism':'past_commitment_and_pending_deadline_force_current_warehouse_demand_above_public_capacity',
  'excludedExplanations':['200ms candidate receipt or selection timeout','5000ms parent cold-episode timeout','missing feasible incumbent alone being mistaken for infeasibility','native baseline success after the same physical prefix'],
  'stillUnknown':['Whether accepting the D4 native fee-tie proposal alone would complete the full actual future path','Which alternate online rule can prevent this loss without new losses or higher full-path fees on new validation','Counterfactual necessity of D1 versus later selection changes; no controlled replay has been run']})
for path,h in sources.items():require(sha(ROOT/path)==h,'Original source changed during read-only diagnosis')
native_metrics={}
for panel,s in index['summary']['panels'].items():
 c=s['comparisons']['v10VsHiGHS'];native_metrics[panel]={'completion':all_pairs[panel]['v10VsHiGHS'],
  'fees':copy.deepcopy(c['fees']),'revisions':copy.deepcopy(c['revisions'])}
output={'schemaVersion':'portplan-v10-loss-diagnosis-v1','valid':True,'generatedAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'readOnlyOriginalEvidence':True,'newSolverCalls':0,'onlinePolicyReruns':0,'newHeldOutExperiments':0,
 'sourceHashes':sources,'frozenRelevantImplementationHashes':relevant,
 'independentLedgerSha256':sha(ROOT/'scripts/review-v5.py'),'independentReviewerSha256':sha(ROOT/'scripts/review-v10.py'),
 'diagnosticImplementationSource':Path(__file__).read_text(),'diagnosticImplementationSha256':sha(__file__),
 'scope':'Posthoc development diagnosis of frozen V10 first-run negative outcomes; no method changes or score replacement',
 'summary':{'comparisonLossCount':3,'uniqueBusinessScenarioCount':1,'algorithmTimingRepeats':3,'failureDay':5,
    'uniqueObservedPrefixModelCount':len(groups),'timelyNativeInfeasibleCount':3,'independentNecessaryConditionViolationCount':3,
    'allBaselineCompletionGainsAndLosses':all_pairs,'defaultRecommendationEligibility':False,
    'netNativePressureGainDoesNotMeanZeroLoss':{'gains':15,'losses':3,'net':12}},
 'diagnosticIdentityGroups':groups,'nativeComparisonMetrics':native_metrics,'episodes':episodes,
 'conclusions':['Three repeated failures are one business scenario, not three independent cases.',
   'D5 current-prefix warehouse infeasibility has both the timely original native status and an independent no-solver necessary-condition contradiction.',
   'The original native baseline followed a different physical prefix from D1; its complete success does not show recovery was possible after V10 past commitments.',
   'D4 retaining a zero-fee cache instead of a zero-fee alternative is a documented stability/resilience tradeoff; switching only D4 has not been tested.',
   'Pressure native completion net +12 retains 3 real losses. All old-baseline losses are retained, so the predefined default gate is not passed.',
   'Conditional fee intervals crossing zero and fewer revisions do not establish global non-regression or a stable fee advantage.']}
dest=ROOT/'data/v10-loss-diagnosis.json'
with dest.open('x')as f:json.dump(output,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'output':str(dest),'bytes':dest.stat().st_size,'episodes':3,'businessScenarios':1,'prefixModels':len(groups),'proofs':[(e['repeatIndex'],e['independentNecessaryConditionProof']['minimumDemand'],e['independentNecessaryConditionProof']['publicCapacity'])for e in episodes]},ensure_ascii=False))

conclusions: Three repeated failures are one business scenario, not three independent cases.
D5 current-prefix warehouse infeasibility has both the timely original native status and an independent no-solver necessary-condition contradiction.
The original native baseline followed a different physical prefix from D1; its complete success does not show recovery was possible after V10 past commitments.
D4 retaining a zero-fee cache instead of a zero-fee alternative is a documented stability/resilience tradeoff; switching only D4 has not been tested.
Pressure native completion net +12 retains 3 real losses. All old-baseline losses are retained, so the predefined default gate is not passed.
Conditional fee intervals crossing zero and fewer revisions do not establish global non-regression or a stable fee advantage.
